evidence.quote: The microstructures and high-temperature tensile properties of as-aged Mg-6Zn-1Mn-4Sn-(0.1, 0.5 and 1.0) Y (wt.%, ZMT614-Y) alloys were investigated

evidence.quote: melted at about 750 ◦C in a ZG-0.01 vacuum induction melting furnace in an Ar atmosphere
The ingots were homogenized at 420 ◦C for 12 h
extruded into bars of 16 mm in diameter at 360 ◦C with an extrusion ratio of 25
After extrusion, the alloys were a solid solution at 440 ◦C for 2 h
then two-step aged at 90 ◦C for 24 h and 180 ◦C for 8 h
